border.description: Start up with a border or not: 0 or 1

background.description: Start up with what background color

printtime.description: Print timestamp as xwatch sees new info: 0 or 1

nlines.description: Number of lines that xwatch should store for scrollback: 10 to 1000

firstwarnings.description: Issue warnings about files at startup: 0 or 1

gag.default: last message repeated | Too much work at interrupt
gag.description: Hide lines containing some text. Separate strings by |

colorstring.description: Special colorations when some string is matched in any logfile

ignore.description: Files never showing up in the xwatch-window. Separate multiple files by |
